name: ifta-fuel-tax-calculator
description: Answers IFTA fuel-tax questions for trucking owner-operators and estimates a quarter's tax owed or credit from miles and gallons per jurisdiction, using official IFTA Q3 2026 rates.

interface.longDescription: Money You're Owed IFTA helps trucking owner-operators with their quarterly IFTA fuel-tax return. Ask when the return is due, how the miles-and-gallons reconciliation works, or what a state or province charges for a fuel, and it answers from the official IFTA Q3 2026 rate matrix, including surcharges (Kentucky, Virginia, Indiana propane) and jurisdictions with no published rate. Give it the miles driven and gallons bought in each jurisdiction and it estimates the quarter's tax owed or credit line by line, with the same maths as the Money You're Owed IFTA calculator on the web, and links to that calculator for a printable worksheet. It gives estimates only, not tax advice, and it does not file returns. It is read-only: it stores nothing and needs no sign-in.
defaultPrompt: When is my Q3 2026 IFTA return due?
What is Kentucky's diesel IFTA rate, including the surcharge?
Estimate my IFTA: Indiana 1200 miles 180 gallons, Kentucky 800 miles 150 gallons, Virginia 1000 miles 150 gallons, diesel.

positive.description: Quarter estimate with surcharges, matching the web calculator's worked sample.
positive.prompt: Estimate my Q3 2026 IFTA, diesel: Indiana 1200 miles and 180 gallons, Kentucky 800 miles and 150 gallons, Virginia 1000 miles and 150 gallons.
positive.expected_behavior: Fleet MPG 6.25; IN $7.56, KY -$4.84 plus $13.44 surcharge, VA $3.36 plus $22.88 surcharge; estimated total due $42.40; link to https://ifta-calculator.pages.dev/?src=chatgpt-app; 'not tax advice' caveat.

positive.description: Due date with the weekend rule.
positive.prompt: When is the Q3 2026 IFTA return due?
positive.expected_behavior: October 31, 2026 is a Saturday, so the return is due Monday November 2, 2026 under IFTA's next-business-day rule; the four quarterly due dates; calculator link.

positive.prompt: What is Kentucky's diesel IFTA rate this quarter?
positive.expected_behavior: Kentucky diesel $0.2200 per gallon plus a $0.1050 surcharge on every taxable gallon (official IFTA Q3 2026 matrix), with the matrix link.

positive.description: Edge: jurisdiction and fuel with no published rate.
positive.prompt: What is Indiana's gasoline IFTA rate for Q3 2026?
positive.expected_behavior: Says the Q3 2026 matrix has no single Indiana gasoline rate because of Indiana's Jul 1 - Sep 5 gas tax holiday, and to check the base jurisdiction's return instructions. It does not invent a rate.
The six-step method: fleet MPG, taxable gallons per jurisdiction, net of gallons bought there, times the rate, surcharges on taxable gallons, sum to owed or credit.

negative.description: Filing for the user: the app files nothing.
negative.prompt: File my IFTA return with Kentucky and pay what I owe.
How much income tax do I owe as a self-employed trucker?
What is the sales tax rate in Texas?

review.commerce_description: The app sells nothing and processes no payments. Answers link only to the IFTA calculator page at ifta-calculator.pages.dev and the official IFTA rate matrix.

publication.release_notes: First release: one read-only tool, answer_ifta_question, with official IFTA Q3 2026 rates and the same maths as the web calculator. Version 1.0.1 renames the listing to Money You're Owed IFTA and adds separate privacy and terms pages.
